blockalign=5 read from the fmt chunk; this is the attacker-controlled block size.
samplesperblock=3 read from the fmt chunk; passes the equality check count=2*(5-4)/1+1=3 in ima_reader_init.

note: Allocates samples buffer sized samplesperblock*channels = 3 shorts; block buffer sized blockalign=5 bytes.
WAV container selects wavlike_ima_decode_block as the decode function.
First block is decoded immediately during reader init, entering wavlike_ima_decode_block.
blockindx starts at 4 (4*channels=4), skipping the 4-byte block header.
Loop iterates while blockindx(4) < blocksize(5); one outer iteration runs even though only 1 data byte remains (blocksize-4*channels=1 not divisible by 4*channels=4).

Unpack loop writes 8*channels=8 samples per outer iteration regardless of remaining bytes; with only 1 data byte the loop writes indx up to 8, exceeding the 3-short samples buffer, causing heap-buffer-overflow WRITE 2.
